findings.summary: Incomplete durable manifest and long-path omissions.
Incomplete failure classification omitted SUBFAILED identities.
Prior-attempt provenance was contradictory and incomplete.
The 234-path boundary depended on a hard-coded allowlist and undocumented exclusions.

future_obligations.text: Obtain independent acceptance of a frozen specification commit before capture authorization.
Implement, commit, review, and freeze the operational capture and verification scripts.
Generate the inventory from the then-current repository and external-root state; do not reuse a historical count.
Include all five questioned tests unless a pre-freeze independently accepted amendment proves a governed exclusion.
Use extended-length enumeration and bind every durable artifact, including both B1 regression sentinels when applicable.
Preserve and source-reconcile every test outcome, including every SUBFAILED identity.
Record every attempt in the append-only ledger without collapsing no-artifact and unstable attempts.
Freeze and recompute all Pass A, Pass B, and final identities; terminate every mismatch as unstable.
Create a complete committed provenance binding for every repository and external evidence dependency.
Conduct a new independent review after the future capture and before any merge consideration.

requirements.expected_result: Draft/capture authority remains distinct from implementation, deployment, and trading authority.
Repository, path, filesystem, raw-byte, and Git identities are explicit and collision-free.
Every enumerated path has one reconciled terminal disposition and status never decides relevance.
Production relevance reaches a fixed point and unresolved dynamic behavior stops.
All discovered tests have deterministic inclusion or reviewed exclusion.
All five questioned tests are included and removal fails.
Registry duplication, conflict, weak rationale/evidence, bad rules, and pattern overreach fail.
Canonical inventory is complete, stable, content-addressed, and bidirectionally equal.
Every governed identity is frozen before Pass A and mutation invalidates the attempt.
Every invoked script/helper is committed or content-bound and cannot drift between passes.
Every attempt is unique, terminal, evidence-backed, and noncontradictory.
Long-path-safe enumeration retains every artifact and both B1 sentinels.
Every recovery-critical internal and external artifact is bound by role, size, hash, authority, and immutability.
Every source outcome is individually retained, classified without relabeling, and total-reconciled, including the historical 156 plus 23 regression.
Pass A, Pass B, and final identities match with no writer or runtime operation.
Every governed ambiguity or mutation terminates rather than receiving an operator waiver.
No capture, merge, implementation, deployment, runtime, phase, bucket, or trading authority is emitted.
